page.notes: The first word of the third group is printed "Exæmen" with the æ at the edge of the scan; the ending of "est" is partly cut off, so the final letter is doubtful. The lines are set in a narrow column with wide spacing between the numbered items. Printed "deniq;" is split at the line end as "de-" / "niq;" with the mark after "niq" partly unclear (possibly a superscript 3 standing for ";"). The left-margin marks beside "Examen" and "curforia" are not printed text and were left out. The large initials E and I are joined to their words.
